inputs.prompt: Requested framing: Insert. Edit the reference photograph into a new camera shot of the SAME scene. Preserve the exact same person and facial identity, hair, outfit, bag, object design, materials, lighting and set architecture from the reference. Change camera position and framing as requested; do not simply repeat the reference composition. MACRO INSERT photograph, camera moved close to ONLY the existing two hands holding the exact same real magnetic compass as the reference: one deep cylindrical brass case with slightly flared base and upper-left hinged open plain brass lid with two interior rivets; clear glass cover; cream dial with printed black cardinal letters N at top, E at right, S at bottom, W at left, in that clockwise order; circular black degree tick ring with alternating long and short ticks; one classic STRAIGHT TWO-ENDED needle with a RED north half pointing toward N and SILVER-WHITE south half pointing toward S, small plain brass center pivot. Keep its case depth, lid, glass, precise letter layout, tick spacing, red/silver needle and small pivot from the reference. No X needle or star, no extra compass or ring/chain. The compass dominates the frame, dial fully visible and readable. Same hand grip and mustard cuffs, same wooden greenhouse bench softly blurred behind. Frame the complete open lid, thick brass sidewall and glass-covered dial, realistic perspective. No head, face, torso, inset or second compass. Change only camera position and crop; preserve compass design and colors exactly.. Keep only elements visible in this framing; do not force a face into a detail or rear view.
